title: styrax platanifolius subsp. stellatus
intro: Styrax platanifolius subsp. stellatus, commonly known as the star-bell styrax, is a plant species in the family Styracaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Styrax platanifolius subsp. stellatus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include stilbenoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
